content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Tampa

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects; alternatives exist for those with high school diplomas and extended experience. Review PMI's full eligibility matrix before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions from anywhere on a schedule that fits your work commitments in Tampa's healthcare, finance, technology, and defense sectors. All instruction is delivered online; you'll earn the formal education hours PMI requires.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and work experience. Pay PMI's examination fee at that time. Processing typically takes several weeks; plan ahead so your approval arrives before your preferred exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center. The PMP exam tests project-management competency across initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and closing processes.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Pursue training, volunteer leadership, or conference attendance in your local job market or beyond. Renew your credential before expiration to remain certified.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
